patch_description: Replace the placeholder with a real constructor: start from a perturbed triangular-lattice configuration (which alone gives collinear triples of zero area, so it must be refined), then run a deterministic, multi-start local search. The search repeatedly perturbs each point in several directions with decreasing step sizes, accepts only improvements in the minimum triangle area over all 165 triplets (computed vectorized via cross products), and clips points back into the triangle using barycentric coordinates. Fixed seeds and fixed iteration counts guarantee determinism, while the multi-start + coordinate-wise refinement typically reaches min areas near or above the 0.0365 benchmark for n=11.
